positions.title: Principal Associate Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and 3D printed components for use in fiber optic sensor beta unit
• Planned and executed heat sensitivity test to examine spectrometer behavior for use in beta unit
• Created schematics, graphs, and designs to summarize and present collected data and functionality of beta unit
• Developed beta unit layouts and machine shop orders using CAD
• Analyzed experimental data, models, and equations using Excel
• Communicated with vendors about part specifications, high intensity environmental conditions and component behavior

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Performed Tabletop SEM, XRD, Contact Angle analysis, & profilometry to analyze laser processed coatings on Magnesium samples
•	Performed biomineralization tests using simulated body fluid
•	Assisted with experimental design and method development

volunteerExperiences.description:
As lead of the Coders Rewards & Recognition Committee:
- Delivered a tiered system of rewards & recognition for 300+ associates based on involvement and volunteer feedback
- Collaborate with external Brand partner on a monthly basis to determine inventory needs, rewards types, and designs required
- Collaborate with other committee leads and conference leads on a monthly basis to ensure cross collaboration within the Coders program
- Coordinate weekly check ins and working sessions with 3 committee members based on mission document created as a team
- Collaborate with Coders Program Leads on a biweekly basis 
- Championed sustainability and give back efforts to allow associates to opt out of physical rewards and instead donate to organizations aligned with the Coders mission statement
- Present new proposals and value add to MVP/Accountable Executive Lead of the Coders program

organizations.name: VUcept
organizations.position: Student VUceptor, Elected Media Co-chair · Aug 2016 - Dec 2018
organizations.description:
-Collaborated with faculty member to mentor and lead orientation for 18 incoming first years
-Planned weekly “Visions” sessions consisting of group cohesion and reflection-based activities to aid mentees with their transition, and facilitate discussions regarding diversity and inclusivity on campus
-Initiated individual mentoring sessions with mentees to provide them with personalized campus resources and information
-Hosted and planned first year events to aid with overall goal of creating a freshmen community on campus, volunteered with the move in process to welcome incoming first years and their families to campus
